name: Azmon
overview: Azmon is identified in Scripture as a geographic marker on the southern border of the land of Canaan. The verses in Numbers 34:4-5 and Joshua 15:4 describe Azmon as a boundary point leading toward the river of Egypt and ultimately to the sea, defining the extent of the southern border of the Promised Land. This location serves a practical purpose in delineating the territory God assigned to His people, underscoring His sovereign provision and precise guidance in establishing Israel's inheritance.
